notes: Two different streets called Earnshaw: the northern one along the top is printed only 'EARNSHAW' (lots 251-319, 50 ft) and is recorded as Earnshaw Street; the southern one is printed 'EARNSHAW (SUPERIOR) (NOT OPEN) AV.' (40 ft) and is recorded as Earnshaw Avenue, the same street as sheet 173's 'EARNSHAW AV. (SUPERIOR AV.)'. Earnshaw Street has a jog at x~1616-1791: the west part's centre is estimated at y~195 (only its south line is on the sheet), the east part's centre is y~324; a 6" pipe runs up the jog at x~1699 and off the top edge. Highland Av (printed 'HIGHLAND AV.', '(UNPAVED)', 50 ft, x 2619-2797) runs from the top edge across Earnshaw St to Dorchester and continues SSE south of Dorchester as 'HIGHLAND ST.' (~43 ft, unlabelled width): the Highland St centreline meets Dorchester's ~80 px west of the Highland Av centreline, so both are recorded as T points (name change at Dorchester). Burnet Av (printed 'BURNET AV.', 50 ft, x 3627-3800) runs from the top edge across Earnshaw St to Dorchester (T). Earnshaw St and Dorchester both continue east of Burnet off the sheet (onto 175). Ithaca (printed 'ITHACA (NOT OPEN)', 40 ft, x 1633-1767) runs from Earnshaw Av (L-shaped junction: Earnshaw Av ends at Ithaca, Ithaca does not continue north) south to Southern. Southern printed 'SOUTHERN AV.' with 37' west of Young and 40' east of it. Young (printed 'YOUNG', no suffix) in two pieces as on 173: north part 45 ft (centre x~488), south part 50 ft (x 369-545, centre ~458); the sheet overlaps 173 by about 2,800 px. Bodman printed 'BODMAN AV.' (50 ft), runs from Young (continues west onto 173) east to Alvin (T). Alvin printed 'ALVIN' (50 ft). Dorchester Av 50 ft. 'AUBURNCREST' is a building name on Earnshaw St, not a street. Scale: 50 ft = ~170 px.
